_meta.methodology: Reviewed the current 346-gym catalog and prior web research files, then researched missing-price records with existing official websites. Used only public official pages and public booking/pricing pages; skipped login-gated forms, email/phone/password/account entry, third-party price claims, and unclear non-SF pricing. Did not overwrite stronger existing evidence.
notes: monthlyPrice is the lowest clean recurring in-person monthly membership when one was published.
monthlyUnlimitedPrice is included when the cheapest membership is class-limited but an unlimited monthly option is also public.
annualFee means a mandatory recurring annual fee, not a prepaid annual membership.
annualPrepayPrice stores prepaid annual membership offers separately from mandatory fees.
enrollmentFee stores mandatory joining/setup fees separately from the monthly price.

gyms.name: Bernal Yoga
gyms.priceNote: Official rates page publishes a One Month Pass for unlimited regular classes at $140. Regular single drop-in amount was not cleanly exposed in the crawled public text.

gyms.name: Bikram Hot Yoga
gyms.priceNote: Official Seacliff rates page lists monthly auto-pay unlimited at $149, single class at $30, and 12-month unlimited at $1,450.

gyms.name: Folk
gyms.priceNote: Official memberships page lists Mini membership at $89/month for up to 4 classes, single drop-in at $35, and usual unlimited membership at $199/month after the new-student intro month.

gyms.name: Glow Yoga & Wellness
gyms.priceNote: Official class rates page lists Silver Glow 4 classes/month at $85, Golden Glow unlimited at $240/month, one class at $35, and a $40 enrollment fee for several monthly memberships. Prepay offer lists 10 plus 2 months Golden Glow at $2,400.

gyms.name: Haum
gyms.priceNote: Official HAUM buy-classes page lists cash prices: Mini membership at $108/month for 4 classes, unlimited monthly with 3-month commitment at $169/month, no-commitment unlimited at $199/month, and drop-in at $35. Page notes card/ACH processing fees may apply.

gyms.name: Divine Yoga Studio
gyms.priceNote: Official SF class pages expose scheduled classes at $18 and a three-class pass on the booking page; no clean ongoing monthly SF membership was found publicly.

gyms.name: Fitness Urbano
gyms.priceNote: Official memberships page lists day pass at $35, monthly anytime access at $135/month, no enrollment fee, and yearly access at $1,458.

gyms.name: Fog City Community Fitness
gyms.priceNote: Official membership page lists unlimited month-to-month auto-bill at $299, prepaid annual unlimited at $3,250, and drop-ins at $35 for visitors with prior CrossFit experience.

gyms.name: Hit Fit SF
gyms.priceNote: Official purchase page lists month-to-month unlimited classes/open gym at $220 every 4 weeks, class drop-in at $30, and a $75 club joining fee. Annual prepay text is internally inconsistent, so it is not recorded as a numeric annual prepay here.

gyms.name: Movement San Francisco
gyms.priceNote: Official memberships and passes page includes San Francisco in the Western Region and lists monthly memberships starting at $121, annual memberships starting at $1,331, 30-day membership at $149, and day pass at $35.

gyms.name: Purusha YogaStudio
gyms.priceNote: Official pricing page lists unlimited monthly membership at $149/month, annual unlimited at $1,499/year, and regular class drop-in at $30.

gyms.name: Pilates on Page
gyms.priceNote: Official POP! rates page lists mat group class single at $17 and springboard class single at $30; no monthly membership was published.

gyms.name: Regular Exercise
gyms.priceNote: Official website states professional fees range from $110 to $150 depending on practitioner credentials and specialty. This is a private-session price, not an open-gym day pass or monthly membership.

gyms.name: San Francisco Fencers' Club
gyms.priceNote: Official FAQ says classes start at $200 per month; no day pass or open-gym price was published.

gyms.name: Soluna Yoga and Wellness
gyms.priceNote: Official homepage lists Basic Membership at $100 for 5 classes/month, Standard at $160 for 9/month, Unlimited at $189/month, single drop-in at $35, and intro three classes for $30.

gyms.name: Tiny Haven Yoga
gyms.priceNote: Official classes page lists single in-person class drop-in at $28 and 4-class in-person package at $100; no monthly membership was published.

gyms.name: Yubalance
gyms.priceNote: Official Noe Valley page lists monthly class memberships: 4-class pack at $109, 8-class at $189, unlimited at $229, drop-in at $30, and annual unlimited at $2,399. Personal training drop-in is listed separately at $75.
